text: たべおわると　ねむってしまう。

patterns.name: 〜と (when)
patterns.explanation: と after a verb means 'whenever this happens, that always follows'. たべおわると = 'when it finishes eating'.

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: てしまう after a verb says the thing happens completely, without being able to help it. ねむってしまう = 'it ends up falling asleep'.

patterns.name: 〜おわる
patterns.explanation: おわる stuck onto a shortened verb means 'finish doing'. たべおわる = 'finish eating'.
